cases.translation: Behold, the Lord rides on a swift cloud.
cases.explain: The noun Господь is the subject of the verb восседает (rides/sits).
The preposition в with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.translation: I will stir up Egyptians against each other.
cases.explain: The direct object of подниму requires the accusative case.
The preposition с (with/against) requires the instrumental case.
The preposition с requires the instrumental case.
The preposition с requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я придам ___ во власть жестокого господина.
cases.translation: I will give the Egyptians into the hand of a harsh master.
cases.explain: The preposition придам requires the accusative object.

cases.translation: The waters of the Nile will dry up.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses possession: waters of the Nile.

reading.ru: Вот Господь восседает на быстром облаке и несется в Египет.
reading.question: How does God come to Egypt according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the Lord rides on a swift cloud to come to Egypt.

reading.ru: Я подниму египтян на египтян. Брат будет сражаться с братом, друг с другом.
reading.question: What internal conflict will God cause in Egypt?
options: Egyptians fighting each other, brother against brother, friend against friend
reading.correct: Egyptians fighting each other, brother against brother, friend against friend
reading.explain: God will stir up internal strife: Egyptian against Egyptian, family against family.

reading.ru: Египтяне падут духом, и я расстрою их замыслы.
reading.question: How will God affect Egypt's morale and plans?
options: Their spirit will fail and their plans will be confused
Their spirit will be uplifted and plans successful
reading.correct: Their spirit will fail and their plans will be confused
reading.explain: The text describes spiritual collapse and the destruction of Egypt's strategies.

reading.ru: Они станут вопрошать идолов и духов умерших, вызывателей мертвых и чародеев.
reading.question: What will the desperate Egyptians turn to?
options: Idols, spirits of the dead, mediums, and sorcerers
reading.correct: Idols, spirits of the dead, mediums, and sorcerers
reading.explain: In desperation, the Egyptians will seek guidance from false spiritual sources.

reading.ru: Воды реки Нила иссохнут, пересохнет русло и станет сушей.
reading.question: What will happen to the waters of the Nile?
options: The waters will dry up, the riverbed will be depleted and become dry land
The Nile will overflow its banks
reading.correct: The waters will dry up, the riverbed will be depleted and become dry land
reading.explain: The text describes complete desiccation of Egypt's vital water source.

reading.ru: Рыбаки будут плакать, все забрасывающие в Нил крючки заплачут.
reading.question: How will the fishermen be affected?
options: They will weep because there will be no fish in the Nile
They will celebrate their increased catch
They will become wealthy from the trade
They will move to other regions immediately
reading.correct: They will weep because there will be no fish in the Nile
reading.explain: The fishermen's livelihoods will be destroyed when the Nile dries up.
